name: Fire Elementaling
description: An elementaling is a manifestation of an element that is lacking sentience, often the result of primordial magic. They commonly present in their raw elemental form but shape themselves to emulate certain creatures such as humanoids or beasts.

actions.name: Flame Swipe
actions.description: The Fire Elementaling swipes with fire at a creature, dealing fire damage. On a true hit, the target gains the ignited condition.

actions.name: Swap
actions.description: The Flame Elementaling teleports to an open flame, extinguishing it. Additionally, the next spell that the Fire Elementaling channels becomes charged until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Fiery Vengeance
actions.description: In response to taking damage from a melee attack, the Fire Elementaling enhances their Flame Shield trait to deal an additional 2d4 fire damage.

traits.name: Elemental
traits.description: Elementals have special protection against physical damage from weapons and ammunition that do not have the magical property, halving any damage before mitigations are applied.

traits.name: Essence of Fire
traits.description: The Fire Elementaling gives off 3 units of light and becomes dazed until the end of it's next turn when targeted with spells or effects that extinguish magical fire.

traits.name: Flame Shield
traits.description: Whenever a creature hits the Fire Elementaling with a melee attack, they take 2d4 fire damage.
